Completed the investigator stage in about **11 minutes 50 seconds**. The single native Goal’s binding check passed; that same Goal is complete. The exact activation response is preserved byte-for-byte in both receipt files. Provenance and freshness remain **UNKNOWN beyond the checker**.

The draft compares a product-neutral operation journal with SQLite, CouchDB/PouchDB, Automerge, and RxDB. It addresses the alternatives’ relevant limits, including CouchDB’s hidden default conflict winner, SQLite Session changesets’ compatible-baseline requirement, and Automerge’s concurrent map delete/set behavior. [CouchDB conflict model](https://docs.couchdb.org/en/stable/replication/conflicts.html), [SQLite Session Extension](https://www.sqlite.org/sessionintro.html), [Automerge merge rules](https://automerge.org/docs/reference/under-the-hood/merge-rules/)
